# Vendored third-party code

`clack.mjs` is an esbuild bundle (ESM, minified) of @clack/prompts 1.9.0 and its dependencies, so the CLI needs no npm install.
Rebuild: `npm i @clack/prompts esbuild && echo 'export * from "@clack/prompts"' > e.mjs && npx esbuild e.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --minify --outfile=clack.mjs`.
